coverage.notes: All figures are WGFD estimates from its voluntary hunter harvest survey, copied as printed. Per hunt area: one row per license type (hunt = WGFD type number, or 'General'; methodLabel keeps the printed label, e.g. 'Limited 1', 'Full 1', 'Reduced 6', 'D/F Type 7'), plus pooled Total / Resident / Nonresident rows (method 'all'), plus harvest by weapon (method 'archery', or 'other' = WGFD 'Firearm'), for which WGFD publishes harvest only, not hunters. For license-type rows 'hunters' = active licenses and 'licenses' = licenses sold incl. cross-area licenses; pooled rows count active hunters, so type rows need not add up to the pooled row (some hunters hold several licenses). Bull / spike / cow / calf ('Bull' = branch-antlered adult male, excludes spikes) counts are in each row's note. Cross-check: the sum of hunt-area totals equals WGFD's published statewide total harvest in every year (2020 26,491; 2021 24,333; 2022 27,011; 2023 28,353; 2024 30,744; 2025 30,568). Where WGFD printed hunter success above 100%, successPct is null and the printed value is in the note. Herd-unit, nonresident-region, confidence-interval and survey-response tables are not imported. 2025 Hunt Area 77 (National Elk Refuge) also lists 'Other' license rows (WGFD: licenses issued for other areas); they are kept with hunt '<type> (Other)'.

For license-type rows 'hunters' = active licenses and 'licenses' = licenses sold incl. cross-area licenses; pooled rows count active hunters, so type rows need not add up to the pooled row (some hunters hold several licenses). Buck / doe / fawn counts are in each row's note. Cross-check: the sum of hunt-area totals equals WGFD's published statewide total harvest in every year (2020 21,370; 2021 18,944; 2022 17,785; 2023 13,572; 2024 15,004; 2025 16,688). Where WGFD printed hunter success above 100%, successPct is null and the printed value is in the note. Herd-unit, nonresident-region, confidence-interval and survey-response tables are not imported. Printed anomalies kept as published and flagged in the row note: 2021 HA 35 weapon table (classes do not add to total), 2024 HA 146 pooled nonresident fawn = 170 with total 5. In 2023 the weapon tables for HA 97, 139 and 144 differ by 1 from the hunt-area totals (WGFD footnote: summed values may not match other tables due to rounding). The 2024 report prints a stray copy of HA 131's last row beside the HA 132 heading; it was ignored.

All figures are WGFD estimates from its voluntary hunter harvest survey, copied as printed. Per hunt area: one row per license type (hunt = WGFD type number, or 'General'; methodLabel keeps the printed label, e.g. 'Limited 1', 'Full 1', 'Reduced 6', 'D/F Type 7'), plus pooled Total / Resident / Nonresident rows (method 'all'), plus harvest by weapon (method 'archery', or 'other' = WGFD 'Firearm'), for which WGFD publishes harvest only, not hunters. For license-type rows 'hunters' = active licenses and 'licenses' = licenses sold incl. cross-area licenses; pooled rows count active hunters, so type rows need not add up to the pooled row (some hunters hold several licenses). Buck / doe / fawn (WGFD calls the species antelope) counts are in each row's note. Cross-check: the sum of hunt-area totals equals WGFD's published statewide total harvest in every year (2020 40,410; 2021 31,965; 2022 28,254; 2023 21,228; 2024 22,218; 2025 22,766). Where WGFD printed hunter success above 100%, successPct is null and the printed value is in the note. Herd-unit, nonresident-region, confidence-interval and survey-response tables are not imported. 2023 HA 79 weapon table differs by 1 from the hunt-area total.

WGFD survey estimates, copied as printed. Per hunt area one row per license type x residency (hunt = printed type number; licenses = valid licenses) plus an area total row (method 'all'). Bull / cow / calf counts are in the note. Sum of area totals equals WGFD's statewide harvest every year (2020 310; 2021 329; 2022 334; 2023 331; 2024 317; 2025 338). Areas WGFD printed as closed or with no activity reported (e.g. 7, 8, 14, 15, 19, 32 in 2020-2023) have no rows. WGFD's per-row license-accounting notes (carry-in / carry-out, donor / donee, Governor's, Supertag, Trifecta licenses) are not reproduced. 2021 and 2022 HA 34 bull/cow/calf as printed do not add to the published total (flagged). 2021 report footnote: three Governor's licenses with unknown hunt area are not in the hunt-area table. Herd-unit tables not imported.

Bighorn sheep, WGFD survey estimates copied as printed. Per hunt area one row per license type x residency plus an area total row (method 'all'); ram / ewe / lamb in the note. Sum of area totals equals WGFD's statewide harvest every year (2020 132; 2021 148; 2022 162; 2023 182; 2024 185; 2025 242). HA 21 was printed as closed in 2020 and 2022. 2020 report footnote: license holders who did not respond to the survey are assumed to have hunted but not harvested. Hunt-area names use the spelling WGFD printed in most years (the 2025 report misspells several, e.g. 'Wapati Ridge', 'Big Piiney'). License-accounting notes (carry-in/out, donor/donee, Governor's, Supertag, Trifecta) and herd-unit tables are not reproduced.

Mountain goat, WGFD survey estimates copied as printed. Per hunt area one row per license type x residency (types printed as 1, 2 or A) plus an area total row; billy / nanny (and kid from 2024) in the note. Sum of area totals equals WGFD's statewide harvest every year (2020 56; 2021 40; 2022 43; 2023 39; 2024 35; 2025 27). Hunt areas 4 and 5 drop out of later reports. Herd-unit tables and license-accounting notes not reproduced.

Black bear, WGFD survey estimates copied as printed. Per hunt area and residency (resident / nonresident / all) three rows: 'Spring season', 'Fall season' and 'Annual (spring + fall)' (method 'all'). WGFD publishes hunter success only for the annual figure; spring/fall success is harvest/hunters (1 decimal, successComputed true) except on the spring/fall 'all' rows, where success and male/female harvest come from WGFD's spring/fall harvest-by-management-unit tables (used only when that table's hunters, days and harvest match the hunt-area table and female + male = total; 7 of 408 season rows lack the split for that reason). Annual hunters are unique hunters, so they are not spring + fall. Sum of annual area totals equals WGFD's statewide harvest every year (2020 537; 2021 563; 2022 526; 2023 582; 2024 631; 2025 656). 2020 HA 15 and 29 (fall and annual): resident + nonresident as printed do not add to the total (flagged). Female mortality limits per management unit are not imported.

Mountain lion. Year = start of the WGFD harvest year: fall (Sep 1 - Dec 31) of that year plus spring (Jan 1 - Mar 31 / Aug 31) of the next year. Per hunt area and residency three rows: 'Fall season', 'Spring season', 'Annual (spring + fall)' (method 'all', WGFD success; fall/spring success computed). Harvest is lions registered with WGFD; hunters and days come from WGFD's hunter survey, so a few rows show harvest with zero or fewer hunters (WGFD lists these cases in a note under each table). Mortality limits from WGFD's management-unit table are in the annual total row note. Sum of annual area totals equals WGFD's statewide harvest (2021 323; 2022 317; 2023 340; 2024 354; 2025 277). 2025: WGFD totals include illegally harvested lions, which are not assigned a residency (flagged where resident + nonresident differs from total). 2020 not delivered: the file labelled '2020-2021' (wgfd.wyo.gov/media/22073) carries the figures WGFD's later ten-year tables assign to the 2019 season (345 lions) rather than 2020 (391).

Wild turkey, WGFD survey estimates copied as printed. Year = calendar year of the season: each WGFD report covers fall Y and spring Y+1 (fall 2020-2025 and spring 2022-2026 delivered). Rows per area: one per license type x residency (hunt 'General' or type number) and an area total (method 'all'); tom / hen in the note. Units: hunt areas 1-5 through spring 2024; from fall 2024 WGFD reports named management areas (unit = area name, counties in unitName), so the two series are not comparable. Area totals match WGFD statewide season totals within 1 (rounding). Not delivered: spring 2021 (the 2020-2021 report's spring section repeats fall-like figures and contradicts the spring 2021 total in later WGFD ten-year tables). The 2024-2025 report prints the spring 2025 table twice with two residency rows swapped; the first copy (which matches WGFD's statewide resident/nonresident totals) is used.
